# Hot Beans Security Instructions

Use this project-specific guidance when checking or fixing the Hot Beans website.

## Priorities
- Confirm whether the site is online before making security or QA changes.
- Prefer focused checks over broad changes.
- Use the security MCP tools for status, header, .git, and UX/UI audits.
- Use browser-based validation when page behavior needs checking.

## Workflow
1. Verify site status.
2. Check the relevant page or issue.
3. Read only the necessary files.
4. Fix the root cause.
5. Re-run the relevant verification step.

## Quality bar
- Keep changes minimal and relevant.
- Explain result in plain terms.
- Do not make unrelated edits.
- Preserve the static-site structure and existing conventions.
